headline: IRGC fires warning shots at two ships attempting illegal passage through Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) fired warning shots at two vessels attempting to illegally cross the Strait of Hormuz, reiterating its stance on regional energy resources.
details: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reportedly fired warning shots at two ships attempting to illegally navigate the Strait of Hormuz. This incident highlights ongoing tensions in the critical maritime choke point.

The IRGC also issued a stern warning regarding Middle East energy resources, stating that they are 'either for everyone, or for no one.' This statement underscores Iran's assertive stance on regional energy security.
